scope: Distinct demonstrated repair themes; raw case counts are not independent defect counts. Global model/client changes are environmental follow-through, not Codeweb source repair.

items.problem: Incomplete or unavailable evidence still returns successful deadcode JSON/MCP safety wording.
items.scope: Correct action/provenance wording and preserve compatibility; incomplete source cannot become a safe-deletion claim.
items.verification: Replay raw missing-source/incomplete/empty CLI and MCP controls; preserve ordinary structural/evidence semantics.

items.problem: Known edit target relevant consumer is omitted in favor of a truthfully labeled but unrelated popular-symbol card.
items.scope: Use supported edit selectors/content when resolvable or explicitly declare incomplete/ambiguous selection; retain valid file-summary and quiet behavior without arbitrary new semantic parser.
items.verification: Exact low/high/file-only/same-file controls and repeated relevant/irrelevant edit events.

items.problem: Mapped corrupt/empty evidence or previously mapped extraction failure is silent like a supported quiet case.
items.scope: Give inspectable bounded diagnostics/recovery within mapped claimed scope; intentionally unmapped/out-of-scope silence is legitimate and must stay quiet.
items.verification: Mapped quiet/corrupt/empty/actual extraction failure controls plus out-of-scope no-noise control.

items.problem: Parseable invalid nodes shape is normalized into an ordinary miss/empty state.
items.scope: Validate supported graph shapes with an explicit invalid-state result while retaining legitimate legacy compatibility.
items.verification: Invalid JSON/shape and valid empty/legacy controls across CLI/MCP.

items.problem: Graph-only hook fallback does not expose stale/unknown freshness when sidecar evidence is unavailable.
items.scope: Use existing freshness evidence consistently and keep unknown distinct; do not manufacture a current map.
items.verification: Fresh/stamped-stale/graph-only-stale and absent-stamp controls with original baseline unchanged.

items.problem: Documented Codex apply_patch input and aliased hook entry paths do not deliver standalone context.
items.scope: Declare supported ambient surfaces explicitly; repair entry/adapter compatibility only for chosen claimed surface, then verify trusted actual-host delivery. Direct payload probes alone do not prove host behavior.
items.verification: Canonical/alias and Claude/Codex payload parity plus actual scoped trusted runtime, or legitimate explicit ambient exclusion.

items.problem: Ordinary mapped post-hook probes repeat unsupported Apple ctags usage on stderr.
items.scope: Inspect optional-tool compatibility/noise without hiding extraction failure; host presentation is not yet observed.
items.verification: Ordinary mapped/no-regression and actual extraction-error controls; actual host stderr visibility separately.

external_unverified_owners.boundary: Authenticated Claude delivery; no new login authorized.
Trusted ambient delivery, recognized generated-dependency exclusion and actual disable/unexposure proof.
Native prompt confinement and out-of-fixture instruction-read contamination.
